title: Learning Inter-Graph Interactions Between Heterogeneous Substructures of Chemical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.27614v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Complex chemical systems containing heterogeneous substructures are common in real-world applications. Various physical phenomena of the complex chemical systems are derived from the interactions between the heterogeneous substructures. However, existing graph representation learning methods for inter-graph interactions assumed graph-level interactions between homogeneous structures, such as organic molecules and inorganic crystalline materials. We propose a data descriptor of the complex chemical systems and a graph neural network for learning inter-graph interactions between organic and inorganic compounds. We applied the proposed method to predict the physical properties of hybrid solar cell materials containing heterogeneous substructures, which have received significant attention for sustainable energy resources. translated_title: 学习化学体系中异质子结构间的图间交互
translated_abstract: 含有异质子结构的复杂化学体系在现实应用中十分常见。这类复杂化学体系的多种物理现象源于异质子结构之间的相互作用。然而，现有的面向图间交互的图表示学习方法假设的是同质结构（例如有机分子和无机晶体材料）之间的图级交互。我们提出了一种复杂化学体系的数据描述符，以及一种用于学习有机化合物与无机化合物之间图间交互的图神经网络。我们将所提出的方法应用于预测含有异质子结构的混合太阳能电池材料的物理性质，这类材料作为可持续能源资源受到了广泛关注。通过学习异质图间交互，所提出的方法在预测（原文摘要在此处截断）方面取得了最先进的准确率。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种描述复杂化学体系的数据描述符和图神经网络方法，用于学习有机与无机化合物之间的异质图间交互，并在混合太阳能电池材料的物理性质预测上取得了最先进的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data descriptor and a graph neural network for learning heterogeneous inter-graph interactions between organic and inorganic compounds, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy in predicting physical properties of hybrid solar cell materials.
